contexts.text: The removal of sins with those who are in good, or who have performed repentance, was represented in the Jewish Church by the he-goat called Azazel [or the scape-goat].
Then Aaron shall place both his hands upon the head of the living goat Azazel ().
How (the Hell in the natural man can be removed) was represented by the he-goat called Azazel, cast out into the wilderness.
